name: trace_id
description: W3C Trace Context 32-hex-character trace identifier.

name: span_id
description: W3C 16-hex-character span identifier.

name: parent_span_id
description: Parent span identifier (NULL for root agent invocation span).

name: span_name
description: OpenTelemetry span name (e.g., invoke_agent, execute_tool, outcome.closed).

name: start_time
description: Span start timestamp in UTC (partition key).

name: end_time
description: Span completion timestamp in UTC.

name: receive_time
description: Observability Analytics ingestion timestamp in UTC (receive_time - end_time measures lag).

name: latency_ms
description: End-to-end span execution latency in milliseconds.

name: status_code
description: OpenTelemetry status code: OK, ERROR, or UNSET.

name: otel_span_kind
description: OpenTelemetry SpanKind (e.g., SPAN_KIND_SERVER, SPAN_KIND_CLIENT, SPAN_KIND_INTERNAL).

name: span_kind
description: GenAI operation name: invoke_agent, execute_tool, chat, embeddings, retrieval, or internal.

name: service_name
description: OTel resource service.name attribute.

name: gcp_apphub_application_id
description: Server-stamped or collector-stamped App Hub Application ID (ADR-003: NULL for unregistered workloads, resolved downstream via COALESCE(..., 'unregistered_app')).

name: gcp_apphub_service_id
description: Cloud App Hub service identifier.

name: gcp_apphub_workload_id
description: Cloud App Hub workload identifier.

name: agent_name
description: Logical agent persona or sub-agent identifier (gen_ai.agent.name).

name: model_name
description: Customer-facing model identifier (e.g., gemini-3.8-flash, gemini-4-argon, gemini-3.5-flash-lite, or none).

name: input_tokens
description: Total prompt tokens (gen_ai.usage.input_tokens), inclusive of cached_input_tokens.

name: cached_input_tokens
description: Cached prefix prompt tokens (gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens) billed at 0.1x (<=200K) or 0.2x (>200K).

name: output_tokens
description: Generated completion tokens (gen_ai.usage.output_tokens) billed at 4.0x (<=200K) or 7.5x (>200K).

name: thinking_tokens
description: Internal reasoning tokens (gen_ai.usage.reasoning.output_tokens / thoughts_tokens) billed at 4.0x (<=200K) or 7.5x (>200K).

name: tool_name
description: Invoked tool identifier when span_kind = execute_tool.

name: tool_call_status
description: Tool execution outcome (SUCCESS, VALIDATION_ERROR, TIMEOUT, RATE_LIMITED).

name: rule0_pass
description: Deterministic Rule 0 schema, citation-anchor, and math verification outcome (EVAL-P01).

name: finops_traffic_type
description: FinOps attribution bucket: production_inference, conflict_escalation, agent_gym_eval, or autorater_judge.

name: outcome_id
description: EVAL-P11 business outcome identifier propagated via W3C baggage (outcome.id).

name: outcome_owner
description: EVAL-P11 owning App Hub application ID propagated via W3C baggage (outcome.owner).

name: source_mode
description: Workflow ingestion/execution lane (e.g., A2A_PATH_A, PDF_PATH_B_FLASH, PDF_PATH_B_ARGON).

name: skill_id
description: Compiled skill identifier applied during span execution (e.g., loan-payoff-statement).

name: skill_version
description: Semantic version of the compiled skill applied during span execution (e.g., 1.0.0, 1.1.0).

name: entity_id
description: Optional business subject identifier recorded on outcome close or trace metadata.

name: attributes
description: Full OpenTelemetry span attribute payload serialized as BigQuery JSON (including prompt/completion payload URIs).
